## Course description

Biochemistry examines the chemistry of life processes. The course explores proteins, enzymes, DNA, RNA, carbohydrates, and lipids, together with their relationships to human health.

**Textbook:** Berg, Tymoczko, Gatto, and Stryer, *Biochemistry*, 9th edition.

## Examination policy

Exams are given during regular class time. Makeup exams are available only for legitimate, documented reasons such as illness, a university-sanctioned out-of-town event, or a death in the immediate family. Students should notify the instructor before an anticipated absence and retain documentation for an unexpected illness or accident.
